intent: A main action joined to a chevron that opens a menu of related actions.
useWhen: One action is the usual choice and a few others are close to it, like Save invoice with Save and send, or Save as draft
A card footer or page header where the other actions would crowd the row as separate Buttons
doNotUseWhen: Filters above a table or list — use FilterButton
A menu with no main action — use DropdownMenu
Two or three equal actions — use separate Buttons or a ButtonGroup
Choosing a value to save — use Select

children.note: Label of the main action, like Save invoice.

groups.note: The other actions, as kit DropdownMenu groups: [{ heading?, items: [{ id, label, icon?, danger?, disabled? }] }].

onSelect.note: (id: string) => void. A menu action was picked.

menuLabel.note: Accessible name of the chevron button. Default: the label plus options, like Save invoice options.

size.note: Both parts use control-height: sm 32, md 36, lg 40. The chevron part is a square.

loading.note: The main action is running. Same as Button loading. The menu still opens.

iconStart.note: Leading icon on the main action.

type.note: Type of the main action button.

align.note: Which edge of the chevron the menu lines up with.

open.note: Controlled menu state. Leave it out and the menu keeps its own.

requirements: Two native buttons: the main action, named by its label, and the chevron, named by menuLabel
The chevron has aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded
The menu follows DropdownMenu: arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns focus to the chevron
Each button has its own focus ring

doNot: Do not build a local split button from two Buttons and a popover
Do not use SplitButton for filters — FilterButton is the split control for filters
Do not put the main action in the menu as well
Do not use more than one appearance=solid mode=primary SplitButton or Button in a view
snippet: <SplitButton onClick={() => {}} onSelect={(id) => {}} groups={[{ items: [{ id: "send", label: "Save and send" }, { id: "draft", label: "Save as draft" }] }]}>Save invoice</SplitButton>
